title: Patch: the dev dashboard's audit reads a time range
thread:
**Issue #4298 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4298: Patch: the dev dashboard's audit reads a time range
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
The dev dashboard has a page listing every admin and dev-tool action ever taken: who did it, which button they pressed, and what changed. Today you can only filter that list by account and by action name, and you page backwards from the newest entry. Once this is built, you can also ask for just one window of time, such as everything from last Tuesday, which turns a long trawl into one lookup. A maintainer tracking down who changed what and when notices; players notice nothing.

## Why
Every write of every dev and admin route appends one row to `admin_actions` (R3074000), and that table only grows: ratings, news posts and take-downs, plus every dev-tool write (XP, Jlore, fills, clears, quest tools). The read side, however, has stood still since it was built: `GET /api/admin/audit` filters only by exact account and exact route with cursor paging, and the dashboard page exposes only those two text boxes. There is no way to ask the natural incident question ("what did anyone do between 2am and 4am?") short of paging through everything newer. No open or closed issue covers audit time filtering (the audit page and its who/what filters shipped under #4168/#4183, now closed).

## Proposal
Add optional `since`/`until` (epoch milliseconds, matching the row's `at` field) to `GET /api/admin/audit` as range bounds on the row id's timestamp, expose them as two date-time inputs on the dashboard's audit page next to the existing filters, and keep everything else unchanged: same page size, same newest-first order, same cursor paging composed with the range. Rejected: relative shortcuts ("last 24h") instead of explicit inputs — explicit bounds compose with the existing cursor and are trivially testable; shortcuts can follow if maintainers want them.

## Where it lands
- `crates/server/src/api/admin.rs` (`get_audit`, `AdminActionFilter`)
- Store: the `admin_actions_page` query in `crates/server/src/db/` (fake and Postgres together, plus the contract test in `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`)
- `apps/admin/src/Audit.tsx` (and `api.ts`, `testids.ts`) for the two inputs
- SPEC §9.1 / R3074000 (the audit paragraph lives there; the change narrows reads, not what is recorded, so the ruling text needs at most a sentence, not a new ruling)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `GET /api/admin/audit?since=&until=` returns only rows in the window, combined with the existing `profile_id`/`route` filters and `before_id` paging
- [ ] Bad bounds (non-numbers, `since` after `until`) are 400 with a sentence, like the existing `before_id` validation
- [ ] The dashboard page offers both bounds, clears them with Clear, and keeps paging inside the window
- [ ] Fake and Postgres agree (contract test), since the Docker suites are the only place RLS/trigger behavior is checked
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-server` (incl. the store contract) and the admin app tests pass

## Size and risks
Small: one bounded range predicate, two inputs, tests on both sides. Risk: timestamp-vs-id ordering edge cases under concurrent writes — mitigated by bounding on the row timestamp while keeping `before_id` as the stable paging cursor, and by asserting newest-first order inside a window in the contract test. Rejected alternative: full-text search over the request/before/after JSON — heavier (needs `pg_trgm` or equivalent, new indexes) for a question time bounds already answer.

---
Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it.

Area: `server` (`suggestions.areas`).

Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it.

## Plan

_Written by `muse` (muse, `muse-spark-1.3-contributor`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44750015630)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Add optional `since`/`until` query bounds (epoch milliseconds, inclusive on the row's `at` field) to `GET /api/admin/audit`, composed with the existing `profile_id`/`route` filters and `before_id` cursor paging, and expose them as two date-time inputs on the dashboard's audit page that Clear resets and Older respects. Bad bounds are 400 with a sentence, like the existing `before_id` validation. Fake and Postgres agree through the store contract test, and the spec's audit paragraph gains one sentence (no new ruling).

## Files to touch

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/server/src/admin/store.rs` | change | `AdminActionFilter` gains `since: Option<i64>`, `until: Option<i64>`; `pg::actions_page` and `fake::actions_page` filter on them |
| `crates/server/src/api/admin.rs` | change | `get_audit` parses/validates `since`/`until`; module and function docs |
| `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` | change | new `audit_pages_by_since_and_until` in mod `dev_dashboard` + register in its `both_stores!` |
| `crates/server/tests/api/admin.rs` | change | new `audit_read_filters_by_since_and_until` |
| `apps/admin/src/api.ts` | change | `audit()` query gains `since?: number; until?: number` |
| `apps/admin/src/Audit.tsx` | change | Since/Until inputs, applied window, Older and Clear |
| `apps/admin/src/testids.ts` | change | add `auditSince`, `auditUntil` |
| `apps/admin/src/api.test.ts` | change | new `CASES` rows for the window params |
| `apps/admin/src/Dashboard.test.tsx` | change | new Audit window tests |
| `spec/14-economy.md` | change | §14.10 audit sentence: one added sentence on `since`/`until` |
| `spec/rulings/R3074000.md` | change | audit paragraph: one added sentence on `since`/`until` |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, anything under `crates/server/migrations/` (no schema change: the bounds read the existing `at` column, already covered by `admin_actions_at_idx (at desc, id desc)`), `apps/web/src/wire/`, or the engine/cards/ai crates. Governing spec: §14.10 and R3074000. No new ruling note, no `spec/pending/` file, and never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

## Steps

1. `crates/server/src/admin/store.rs`, `AdminActionFilter` (line 80): add `pub since: Option<i64>` and `pub until: Option<i64>` with a doc line each (`since`/`until` are inclusive lower/upper bounds on the row's `at`, epoch ms; `None` means no constraint). Update the struct's doc comment to name all five fields.
2. Same file, `pg::actions_page` (line 427): extend the `where` clause with `and ($5::double precision is null or at >= to_timestamp($5::double precision / 1000.0))` and `and ($6::double precision is null or at <= to_timestamp($6::double precision / 1000.0))`, copying the conversion in `pg::posts_standing`; `.bind(filter.since)` and `.bind(filter.until)` after the existing four binds. Keep `order by at desc, id desc` and `limit $1` untouched.
3. Same file, `fake::actions_page` (line 694): insert `.filter(|row| filter.since.is_none_or(|since| row.at >= since))` and `.filter(|row| filter.until.is_none_or(|until| row.at <= until))` before the `newest_first` call. Keep the sort and `take(limit)` untouched.
4. `crates/server/src/api/admin.rs`, `get_audit` (line 385): parse `since`/`until` like `before_id`, but treat a missing or all-whitespace value as `None` (reuse the `present` trim-and-drop-empty shape, then `parse::<i64>()`). Exact errors via `bad_request`: `"since must be a whole number"`, `"until must be a whole number"`, and when both are present and `since > until`, `"since must not be after until"`. Set `AdminActionFilter { before_id, profile_id, route, since, until }`.
5. Same file: update the module doc (lines 14-15) and `get_audit` doc (lines 379-384) to name `?since=<ms>&until=<ms>` as optional inclusive bounds on `at`, composed with the other filters, with `before_id` still the paging cursor.
6. `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`, mod `dev_dashboard`: add `audit_pages_by_since_and_until` beside `audit_pages_by_cursor_and_filter`, following its shape (`action()` helper, `ids` order helper). Write 5 rows with distinct `at` values (two sharing one `at` to lock the `(at desc, id desc)` tie-break), then assert: a middle window returns exactly its rows newest-first; window plus `profile_id` and plus `route`; window plus `before_id` pages inside the window with no gaps/repeats; empty window returns nothing. Register the name in the `both_stores!` list at line 13046.
7. `crates/server/tests/api/admin.rs`: add `audit_read_filters_by_since_and_until` after `audit_read_pages_by_cursor_and_filters`. Seed three writes, read their `at` values from the audit, then assert: `?since=&until=` narrows to the window; combined with `profile_id` and `route`; `?before_id=` pages inside the window; `?since=abc`, `?until=abc`, and `since` after `until` each answer 400.
8. `apps/admin/src/api.ts`, `audit` (line 126): widen the query type with `since?: number; until?: number` and add `if (query?.since !== undefined) params.set("since", String(query.since));` and the same for `until`.
9. `apps/admin/src/testids.ts`: add `auditSince: "admin-audit-since"` and `auditUntil: "admin-audit-until"` after `auditRoute`, matching existing naming.
10. `apps/admin/src/Audit.tsx`: add `sinceInput`/`untilInput` string state and extend `applied` to `{ profileId, route, since?: number, until?: number }`. Add a `toMs` helper (trim; empty yields `undefined`; else `Date.parse`, with `NaN` yielding `undefined`). Render two `<input type="datetime-local">` controls with `Since`/`Until` labels and the new testids next to the existing filters. Pass `since: applied.since, until: applied.until` in both the initial `api.audit` call and `older()`. `Apply` parses both inputs into `applied`; `Clear` empties all four inputs and applied. Server 400 text surfaces through the existing `error` path; no new error UI.
11. `spec/14-economy.md` §14.10: extend the sentence "`profile_id` and `route` narrow the read to one acting account or one route." with one sentence: "`since` and `until` narrow it to rows with `at` in that epoch-millisecond window, inclusive, composed with the other filters and `before_id` paging." Mirror it in one sentence in `spec/rulings/R3074000.md`'s audit paragraph.

## Tests

- `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs`: new `audit_pages_by_since_and_until` asserts window filtering, combination with `profile_id`/`route`/`before_id`, newest-first order inside the window (including the shared-`at` tie-break), and the empty window. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server_store dev_dashboard`.
- `crates/server/tests/api/admin.rs`: new `audit_read_filters_by_since_and_until` asserts window reads, composed filters, in-window paging, and the three 400 cases. Run `cargo test -p jackioh-server --test server api::admin::`.
- `apps/admin/src/api.test.ts`: add `CASES` rows: `audit` with `{ since, until }` sends `/api/admin/audit?since=…&until=…`, and window params combined with `beforeId`/`profileId`/`route`; blanks still omitted. Run `pnpm --dir apps/admin test src/api.test.ts`.
- `apps/admin/src/Dashboard.test.tsx`, `describe("Audit")`: add "Apply sends the time window and replaces the list" (type into the Since/Until inputs, Apply, expect the windowed URL sent once and rows replaced), "Clear empties the time window too" (inputs cleared, unfiltered read re-sent), and "Older keeps the time window" (Older request carries `before_id` plus the window params). Run `pnpm --dir apps/admin test src/Dashboard.test.tsx`.
- Checks: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-server --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Done when

- [ ] `GET /api/admin/audit?since=&until=` returns only rows with `since <= at <= until`, combined with `profile_id`/`route` and `before_id` paging; page size and newest-first order unchanged.
- [ ] Non-numeric `since`/`until` and `since` after `until` are 400 with a sentence.
- [ ] The audit page shows Since and Until inputs, Clear resets them, and Older stays inside the window.
- [ ] The contract test passes on both stores (Postgres half runs in the Docker suite).
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-server` (both test targets above), the two admin app test files, fmt, clippy, and `cargo jackioh spec check` all pass.

## Risks

- Timestamp-vs-id skew under concurrent writes: two rows can share an `at` with `id`s in either order. Mitigation, already in the design: the window bounds only `at`, while `before_id` stays the stable id-based paging cursor and ordering stays `(at desc, id desc)` in both stores; the contract test locks the shared-`at` tie-break and in-window paging.
- Fake/Postgres drift: both implementations change in the same step and the same contract test runs against both; the Docker suite is the only place RLS/trigger behavior is checked, and this change adds no migration so those invariants are untouched.
- No hidden-information or client-enforcement risk: the audit stays dev-only behind `admin_caller`, and the client only forwards typed input (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- `datetime-local` parses in the browser's local zone while rows are epoch ms; acceptable for a dev tool, and tests pin the wire format (epoch-ms integers), not the widget's zone.

## Open questions

None.
```
